test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who wrote the book "Mein Kampf"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adolf Hitler**__.

**__Key Points__**
__

• **Mein Kampf**, which translates to **'My Struggle'**, is an autobiographical manifesto written by the **Nazi Party** leader **Adolf Hitler**. It outlines his political ideology and future plans for **Germany**.

• The book was written while **Hitler** was imprisoned in **Landsberg Prison** in **1924**. He was serving a sentence for **high treason** following the failed **Beer Hall Putsch** (also known as the **Munich Putsch**) of **November 1923**.

• The work was published in two volumes: the first in **1925** and the second in **1926**. It was edited by **Hitler's** deputy, **Rudolf Hess**, who also took dictation for parts of the book while they were both in prison. ***Hence, Option 1 is correct.***

• The book was originally titled 'Four and a Half Years of Struggle against Lies, Stupidity and Cowardice', but the title was shortened to **Mein Kampf** by his publisher, **Max Amann**.

• In the book, **Hitler** details his childhood, his years in **Vienna**, and his experiences during **World War I**, while articulating his **anti-Semitic** and **nationalist** views.

**Additional Information__**
__

• **Joseph Goebbels** (Option 2): He served as the **Reich Minister of Propaganda** of **Nazi Germany** from **1933 to 1945**. He was one of **Adolf Hitler's** closest and most devoted acolytes, known for his skills in public speaking and his deep-seated **anti-Semitism**.

• **Heinrich Himmler** (Option 3): He was the **Reichsführer of the Schutzstaffel (SS)** and a leading member of the **Nazi Party**. **Himmler** was one of the most powerful men in **Nazi Germany** and a main architect of the **Holocaust**.

• **Rudolf Hess** (Option 4): He was a prominent politician in **Nazi Germany** and served as **Deputy Führer** to **Adolf Hitler** from **1933 to 1941**. While he assisted in the creation of **Mein Kampf**, he is not the primary author.

• **Ideological Themes**: The book promotes the concept of **Lebensraum** (living space), asserting that **Germany** needed to expand its territory to the east, particularly into **Russia**, to sustain the **Aryan race**.

• **Impact**: After **Hitler** became **Chancellor of Germany** in **1933**, the book became a massive bestseller. It was considered the **'Bible of National Socialism'** and was frequently given as a gift to newlywed couples and soldiers.

**Important Points__**

• **Copyright History**: After **World War II** and **Hitler's** death in **1945**, the copyright of **Mein Kampf** was transferred to the state of **Bavaria**. The **Bavarian government** refused to allow any new editions to be printed in **Germany** to prevent the spread of **Nazi** ideology.

• **Public Domain**: The copyright expired on **December 31, 2015**, exactly **70 years** after the author's death. This led to the publication of a heavily **annotated edition** by the **Institute of Contemporary History** in **Munich** in **2016**, intended for academic and historical study.

• **Social Darwinism**: The book is heavily influenced by **Social Darwinism**, portraying human history as a perpetual struggle between races, with the **Aryan race** at the top of the hierarchy.

• **Global Reach**: Despite its controversial nature, the book has been translated into numerous languages and remains a subject of intense historical analysis to understand the roots of the **Third Reich** and the **Second World War**.
